已收集到全部所需材料。下面给出完整回答。

---

## 1. Intelligent Cloud 本季度收入同比增长

**计算过程（来源：press_release.txt 位置 18895–18920 的分部利润表）：**

| 项目 | Q4 FY26（截至2026年6月30日三个月） | Q4 FY25（截至2025年6月30日三个月） |
|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306 百万 | $29,878 百万 |

同比增长 = ($39,306 − $29,878) ÷ $29,878 = **31.55%，四舍五入为 32%**（按报告口径）。

按恒定汇率口径：增长 **31%**（press_release.txt 同时披露汇率影响为 +$80M；transcript.txt 24808 亦确认 "grew 32% and 31% in constant currency"）。

---

## 2. 管理层归因（引用电话会原话，来源：transcript.txt 24808–25606）

**分部总览：**
> "Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."

**Azure 与云服务（收入增长 43%）归因：**
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. **Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

**本地服务器业务（同比基本持平，恒定汇率 -1%）归因：**
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

**分部毛利率与营业利润：**
> "Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by **sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand**, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure. Segment gross margins were also impacted by growing GitHub Copilot usage, though margins improved through the quarter with the June business model change to usage-based pricing."
>
> "Operating income grew 31% and operating margins…were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%."

---

## 3. 事实 vs 前瞻性表述的逐条区分

**判断依据**：已发生的事实是对 FY26 Q4（截至 2026-06-30）实际经营结果的描述，通常带有具体数字且使用过去式；前瞻性表述是对未来期间的指引、预期或将持续状态的判断，通常带有 "expect"、"remain focused"、"continue to expect"、"will" 等词语，或指向未来季度/财年。

| # | 归因表述 | 性质 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | **事实**（是对本季度状态的描述，使用 continues 描述当前持续状态） | 出现在回顾本季度业绩的段落中，且紧接其后是"Revenue growth was ahead of expectations"——对已发生结果的总结 |
| 2 | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" | **事实** | 过去式 "was"，是对本季度实际增长超预期的归因 |
| 3 | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" | **事实** | 描述本季度已经完成并产生效果的改进 |
| 4 | "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" | **事实** | 过去式 "was"，描述本季度内已发生的变现 |
| 5 | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" | **事实** | June 业务模式调整已发生，"consumption" 为本季度已实现的消费 |
| 6 | "June business model change to align pricing with usage and value" | **事实** | 明确的时间点（June）+ 已完成的改变 |
| 7 | "sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand" | **事实** | 描述本季度已经发生的组合迁移和基础设施扩展 |
| 8 | "renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts"（本地服务器） | **事实** | 描述本季度已发生的续约情况 |
| 9 | "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" | **前瞻** | "remain focused on delivering" 指向未来持续行动；"bridge the gaps we see" 指向未来要解决的问题 |
| 10 | "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | **前瞻** | 明确使用 "continue to expect"，指向 FY27 上半年的增长加速预期 |
| 11 | "For Intelligent Cloud, we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion, or growth of 33% to 34%. In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency" | **前瞻** | 明确的 Q1 FY27 指引，使用 "we expect" |
| 12 | "year-over-year Azure growth rates can vary quarter-to-quarter based on capacity timing and contract mix" | **前瞻（风险提示）** | 提醒未来季度波动性的免责说明 |

**小结**：第 1–8 条为已发生的事实归因（有本季度具体业绩数字支撑，使用过去式或描述已完成的行动）；第 9–12 条为管理层对 FY27 未来期间的前瞻性表述（带有 "expect / remain focused / continue to expect / can vary" 等指引性措辞）。这一区分完全基于措辞时态与上下文语境，而非印象判断。
